title: Average divisibility in character tables of $\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb{F}_q)$
summary: Let $q$ range over odd prime powers and let $G_q=\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb{F}_q)$. Fix a prime number $\ell$. Motivated by work of Peluse and Soundararajan on Miller's conjecture for character tables of symmetric groups, we study the proportion of entries in the character table of $G_q$ which are not divisible by $\ell$, in the sense of divisibility in the ring of algebraic integers. We prove that $N_\ell(q)=\frac{q^4}{2}+O_ε(q^{3+ε})$ for every $ε>0$, where $N_\ell(q)$ denotes the number of entries which are not divisible by $\ell$.
